question: What protective and granting requests are addressed to the slayer of the ten-headed demon?
premises: The deity is addressed as the slayer of the ten-headed one.
The speaker asks that prosperity be given and caused to be given.
inference: The formula petitions Rāma to protect the speaker and bestow prosperity.
plain_english: O slayer of the ten-headed one, protect me, give and cause prosperity to be given to me.
